subject.title: fix(compaction): prevent repeated restarts after safety timeouts

question: Should a wrapper-owned compaction safety timeout permit one explicitly marked partial compaction result to mutate and persist session state during the bounded settlement window?
rationale: The code can enforce a narrow reason-owned window, but whether state may commit after the caller has observed a timeout is a session-consistency and user-expectation policy choice that source inspection cannot decide.

options.title: Approve bounded partial commit
options.body: Accept the typed, reason-owned settlement window after restoring the shared Pi timeout dependency and proving both runtimes.

options.title: Keep timeouts terminal
options.body: Require compaction progress to be checkpointed before timeout or redesigned so no session mutation occurs after wrapper rejection.
